items.theme: World's largest high-speed rail network (travel writer)
items.title: Visiting China? Here's how to get around in the country
items.quote_en: Indeed, this is the world's largest high-speed-rail network, connecting more than 500 cities. These ultra-modern trains reach speeds of up to 217mph (350km/h), making long distances surprisingly manageable.
items.quote_cn: Lonely Planet：中国拥有全球最大高铁网，连接逾500座城市，时速最高约350km/h。
items.statement_for_kb: According to Lonely Planet, China operates the world's largest high-speed rail network connecting more than 500 cities, with trains reaching up to about 350 km/h.

items.title: Visiting China? Here's how to get around in the country
items.quote_en: Since China is a largely cashless society, most transactions require digital payment apps like WeChat Pay or Alipay, which are essential for everything from metro fares to street food.
items.quote_cn: 中国大体已是无现金社会，地铁与街头小吃等日常支付常依赖微信/支付宝。
items.statement_for_kb: Travel guides note that everyday life in Chinese cities is largely cashless, with WeChat Pay and Alipay widely used for metro fares, street food and other daily transactions.

items.theme: Beijing hutongs as lived neighborhood culture
items.title: Discover the best neighborhoods to visit in Beijing
items.quote_en: Bookended by the magnificent sights of the 13th-century Drum Tower and the 15th-century Bell Tower, and the gorgeous 17th-century architecture of the Tibetan Buddhist Lama Temple, this is Beijing's buzziest district of historical hutong alleyways.
items.quote_cn: 鼓楼、钟楼与雍和宫一带的胡同，是体验北京日常街巷生活的代表性街区。
items.statement_for_kb: Lonely Planet describes Beijing hutong districts around Gulou and the Lama Temple as places where visitors encounter historic alleyway life on a human scale.

items.title: How to get around in Beijing
items.quote_en: Beijing is a safe city, and it's tourist-friendly too. Plus you'll find plenty of signage to go with a fast, cheap and efficient transport system. Getting lost among a labyrinth of hutongs, or narrow alleyways, is a quintessential Beijing experience.
items.quote_cn: 北京交通快捷、标识较多，胡同漫步是常见城市体验。
items.statement_for_kb: Travel writers describe Beijing as relatively tourist-friendly with fast public transport and hutong walking as a classic everyday-city experience.

items.theme: Expat lived experience of mobile payments
items.title: What It's Like To Live in a Cashless Society
items.quote_en: Shanghai-based Toby Graham... 'In the last four months, because of work, I have traveled to seven major cities in China and all I took with me was a passport, some clothes, and my phone... At no point did I need to take cash out.'
items.quote_cn: 在华外籍居民称可在多个中国城市仅凭手机完成支付，长时间无需现金。
items.statement_for_kb: Foreign residents interviewed by VICE report living for years in Chinese cities using primarily WeChat Pay/Alipay, sometimes traveling across major cities with only a phone and no cash.

items.theme: Mobile payments embedded in urban ecosystems
items.title: Alipay and WeChat Prove That China's Future Is Cashless
items.quote_en: Only in societies where internet ecosystems have developed to the point that mobile payments can be used in urban daily life — for example, to make face to face payments, to pay utility bills, to buy tickets for travel, to book hotels, to order takeout, or to rent bicycles — can the likes of Yu'e Bao and WeChat Wallet be allowed to capture and retain large numbers of users.
items.quote_cn: Sixth Tone：移动支付已嵌入面对面付款、水电、出行、酒店、外卖与共享单车等城市日常场景。
items.statement_for_kb: Sixth Tone explains that Alipay and WeChat Pay spread because they cover everyday urban needs: face-to-face payments, utilities, tickets, hotels, takeout and bike rental.

items.title: Sichuan Giant Panda Sanctuaries
items.quote_en: Sichuan Giant Panda Sanctuaries, home to more than 30% of the world's pandas which are classed as highly endangered, covers 924,500 ha with seven nature reserves and nine scenic parks... The sanctuaries constitute the largest remaining contiguous habitat of the giant panda.
items.quote_cn: 四川大熊猫栖息地世界遗产：面积约92.45万公顷，栖息全球逾30%大熊猫，是现存最大连片栖息地。
items.statement_for_kb: UNESCO lists the Sichuan Giant Panda Sanctuaries (2006) as covering about 924,500 ha and hosting more than 30% of the world's giant pandas — the largest remaining contiguous panda habitat.

items.title: Sichuan-Qinghai Railway's new section goes the extra mile for pandas
items.quote_en: In order to minimize the impact on ecological corridors that are crucial to exchanges between different groups of giant pandas, the railway either makes detours or goes through tunnels as deep as possible... tunnels under the Tudiling giant panda corridor are buried more than 1,000 meters deep.
items.quote_cn: 川青铁路为避让大熊猫国家公园与生态廊道，采取绕行或深埋隧道（土顶岭廊道隧道埋深逾1000米）。
items.statement_for_kb: CGTN reports the Sichuan-Qinghai Railway section was designed with detours and deep tunnels (over 1,000 m under the Tudiling panda corridor) to reduce impact on giant panda habitats.

items.title: Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor
items.quote_en: This property is a 5,000 km section of the extensive Silk Roads network, stretching from Chang'an/Luoyang... to the Zhetysu region of Central Asia... linking multiple civilizations and facilitating far-reaching exchanges of activities in trade, religious beliefs, scientific knowledge, technological innovation, cultural practices and the arts.
items.quote_cn: 丝绸之路：长安—天山廊道（约5000公里）连接多文明，促进贸易、信仰、科技与文化交流。
items.statement_for_kb: UNESCO's Silk Roads Chang'an-Tianshan Corridor (inscribed 2014) spans about 5,000 km from Chang'an/Luoyang into Central Asia and documents long-distance exchange of trade, beliefs, knowledge and arts.

items.title: Chinese Language Day
items.quote_en: Language Days at the United Nations seek to celebrate multilingualism and cultural diversity as well as to promote equal use of all six official languages throughout the Organization. Chinese was established as an official language of the United Nations in 1946... In 1973, the General Assembly included Chinese as a working language.
items.quote_cn: 联合国设中文日以庆祝多语与文化多样性；中文1946年为联合国正式语文，1973年联大将其列为工作语文。
items.statement_for_kb: The United Nations observes Chinese Language Day to promote multilingualism; Chinese has been an official UN language since 1946 and a General Assembly working language since 1973.

items.theme: Why April 20 for Chinese Language Day
items.title: Chinese Language Day
items.quote_en: The date for the Chinese day was selected from Guyu ('Rain of Millet'), which is the 6th of 24 solar terms... to pay tribute to Cangjie... claimed to be... the inventor of Chinese characters.
items.quote_cn: 中文日定在谷雨前后，以纪念传说中创造汉字的仓颉。
items.statement_for_kb: UN Chinese Language Day is linked to the solar term Guyu (around April 20) in tribute to the legendary inventor of Chinese characters, Cangjie.

items.theme: IOC on Beijing 2022 winter sports participation legacy
items.title: IOC hails Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics legacy
items.quote_en: Hosting the Olympics has attracted 346 million Chinese in winter sports since 2015, said the article. The number is expected to exceed 520 million in the 2024-2025 snow and ice season... 45.4 percent of the athletes were women, the highest proportion of female athletes ever at a Winter Olympics event.
items.quote_cn: IOC相关文章称：自2015年以来约3.46亿中国人参与冰雪运动；北京冬奥女运动员占比45.4%，为冬奥历史最高。
items.statement_for_kb: CGTN citing IOC material: Beijing 2022 helped draw hundreds of millions of Chinese into winter sports since 2015, and the Games had a record share of women athletes (45.4%) for a Winter Olympics.

items.theme: Olympic venues reused for public winter tourism
items.title: Olympic legacies boost Beijing, Zhangjiakou winter sports
items.quote_en: Beijing and Zhangjiakou... have established a sports, culture, and tourism belt to preserve the Olympic legacies... During the Spring Festival holiday... Chongli received 470,000 tourists, generating a total revenue of over 500 million yuan.
items.quote_cn: 京张共建冬奥遗产体育文旅带；春节假期崇礼接待游客约47万人次，收入逾5亿元。
items.statement_for_kb: Post-Games, Beijing and Zhangjiakou developed a sports-culture-tourism belt around Olympic venues; Chongli alone drew about 470,000 visitors over one Spring Festival holiday period.

items.theme: Continued public use of Winter Olympic venues
items.title: China enjoys winter sports boom even a year after Beijing 2022
items.quote_en: Over 300 million people across China reaped the benefits of the government push and had first-hand experience of various snow activities... enthusiasm among the Chinese people for ice and snow sports shows no signs of abating.
items.quote_cn: 冬奥筹备带动逾3亿人体验冰雪运动；赛后民众热情仍在延续。
items.statement_for_kb: CGTN reports that more than 300 million people in China experienced ice-and-snow sports around the Beijing 2022 push, with strong public interest continuing after the Games.

items.title: Educational empowerment: China's path to women's progress
items.quote_en: In 2024 female students constituted more than half of total higher education enrollment... women now account for 50 percent of graduate students... These headline numbers rest on a primary-school net enrolment rate for girls of 99.9 percent.
items.quote_cn: 2024年高等教育在校生中女生过半，研究生中女性约占50%；女童小学净入学率约99.9%。
items.statement_for_kb: CGTN citing China's white paper: by 2024 women made up more than half of higher-education enrollment and about half of graduate students, with girls' primary net enrollment around 99.9%.

items.theme: Spring Bud Project for rural girls
items.title: Educational empowerment: China's path to women's progress
items.quote_en: By the end of 2024, the [Spring Bud] initiative had mobilized 3.44 billion yuan ($481 million), providing financial assistance and academic support to 4.36 million girls... These achievements brought the project a UNESCO Prize for Girls' and Women's Education in 2023.
items.quote_cn: 春蕾计划截至2024年底筹资约34.4亿元，惠及436万女童，并获2023年联合国教科文组织女童和妇女教育奖。
items.statement_for_kb: The Spring Bud Project had supported about 4.36 million girls by end-2024 and received a UNESCO Prize for Girls' and Women's Education in 2023.

items.theme: UN Women on Chinese women entrepreneurs
items.title: UN Women Asia-Pacific chief on China's progress in gender equality
items.quote_en: UN Women's Regional Director for Asia and the Pacific Christine Arab... noting that 'about 55 percent of China's internet entrepreneurs are women,' and that 'China's progress in fields traditionally dominated by men, such as engineering, is truly impressive.'
items.quote_cn: 联合国妇女署亚太区域主任称：中国约55%的互联网创业者为女性，工程等传统男性主导领域进步显著。
items.statement_for_kb: UN Women's Asia-Pacific regional director told CGTN that about 55% of China's internet entrepreneurs are women and highlighted progress in fields such as engineering.

items.title: Guiyang-Nanning High-speed Railway exemplifies eco-friendly design
items.quote_en: The Guiyang-Nanning High-speed Railway, stretching 482 kilometers and passing through 41 environmentally sensitive areas, is characterized by its green and eco-friendly design... engineers have taken targeted measures to optimize routes, minimize ecological disturbance.
items.quote_cn: 贵南高铁全长约482公里，途经41处环境敏感区，通过优化选线等降低生态干扰。
items.statement_for_kb: CGTN reports the Guiyang-Nanning HSR (about 482 km) crosses 41 environmentally sensitive areas and was planned with route optimization and protective measures to reduce ecological impact.
